obligation: FSIS notification of adulterated or misbranded product in commerce
trigger: Establishment learns or determines that adulterated or misbranded product received by or originating from it has entered commerce (for example, product shipped while cook, chill, or cold storage CCPs were unmonitored, or after an unexplained setpoint or formulation change, and evaluation finds it adulterated or misbranded)
deadline: Within 24 hours of learning or determining; include type, amount, origin, and destination of the product
notify: Local FSIS District Office (also brief the FSIS inspection personnel on site)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - both plants are official establishments
clock_starts: Learning or determining (not discovery of the cyber incident); the determination must be made with reasonable speed
owner: Vice President of Food Safety and Quality Assurance

obligation: Product hold and review for unforeseen deviations (internal, regulatory)
trigger: CCP control or monitoring lost or untrustworthy during an incident
deadline: Immediately: segregate and hold affected product until reviewed; no release until records are complete (417.5(c))
notify: Internal (Plant FSQA Manager); FSIS personnel on site informed
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - both plants

obligation: CERCLA release notification (ammonia)
citation: 40 CFR 302.6; RQ 100 lb for ammonia in 40 CFR 302.4
trigger: Release of anhydrous ammonia of 100 lb or more in any 24-hour period (for example, after loss or manipulation of refrigeration control)
deadline: Immediately on knowledge of the release
notify: National Response Center
applies_at_this_tier: Conditional - only if a release reaches the reportable quantity

obligation: EPCRA emergency release notification (ammonia)
trigger: Release of a reportable quantity of an extremely hazardous substance or CERCLA hazardous substance in 24 hours; exempt if exposure is solely within the facility boundaries (355.31(a))
deadline: Immediate notification, then a written follow-up as soon as practicable
notify: Community emergency coordinator for the LEPC of any area likely affected, and the SERC of any state likely affected
applies_at_this_tier: Conditional - only for a release that can expose people off site

obligation: PSM and RMP incident investigation
trigger: Incident that resulted in, or could reasonably have resulted in, a catastrophic release (including a compromise of a refrigeration controller, per company policy POL-03 4.6)
deadline: Investigation initiated within 48 hours; report with contributing factors; resolution documented; reports kept 5 years
notify: Internal investigation team (at least one person knowledgeable in the process; the refrigeration contractor if its work was involved)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - both ammonia processes

obligation: Florida breach notice to individuals
trigger: Breach of security of personal information of Florida residents (employee data in the HR and payroll SaaS, file shares, or email)
deadline: No later than 30 days after the determination of a breach or reason to believe a breach occurred (15-day extension only for good cause, in writing to the Department within 30 days)
notify: Affected Florida residents
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - if employee personal information is accessed

obligation: Florida notice to the Department of Legal Affairs
trigger: Breach affecting 500 or more individuals in Florida
deadline: No later than 30 days after the determination of the breach (no extension)
notify: Florida Department of Legal Affairs
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if 500 or more Floridians (about 850 employees could be affected)

obligation: Florida notice to consumer reporting agencies
trigger: Notice required to more than 1,000 individuals at a single time
deadline: Without unreasonable delay
notify: All nationwide consumer reporting agencies
applies_at_this_tier: Yes if more than 1,000 (employees plus former employees and temporaries)

obligation: Florida third-party agent notice (inbound)
trigger: A vendor that maintains personal information for the company (HR, payroll, or benefits SaaS) discovers a breach
deadline: Vendor must notify the company within 10 days of the determination of the breach
notify: The company (General Counsel and Security Manager)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - track in vendor contracts (P03 G-079)

obligation: Other state breach notification (worked example: Florida)
citation: State breach notification statutes in each state where affected individuals reside
trigger: Breach of personal information of residents of other states (about 40 Plant 2 employees live in Georgia; former employees may live anywhere)
deadline: Varies by state
notify: Affected residents; state attorney general or regulator where the state requires it
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - counsel checks the affected list by state of residence

obligation: OFAC sanctions check before any ransom payment
citation: OFAC Updated Advisory on Potential Sanctions Risks for Facilitating Ransomware Payments (2021-09-21); 31 CFR chapter V
trigger: Considering a ransomware payment
deadline: Before any payment; prompt reporting to law enforcement or CISA is a mitigating factor
notify: OFAC (license if a sanctioned party is involved); FBI or CISA
applies_at_this_tier: All U.S. persons (strict liability for payments to sanctioned parties)

obligation: Voluntary report to FBI and CISA
trigger: Ransomware, suspected process tampering, or other significant cyber incident
deadline: As soon as practicable (Day 0 to Day 2 in the runbooks)
notify: FBI field office or IC3; CISA
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - voluntary; supports OFAC mitigation and can bring OT response help

obligation: CIRCIA covered cyber incident report and ransom payment report (PROPOSED - not in effect)
trigger: Covered cyber incident (reasonable belief) or ransom payment
deadline: 72 hours after reasonable belief; 24 hours after a ransom payment (proposed)
notify: CISA
applies_at_this_tier: No - final rule not published as of 2026-09-25; coverage would depend on the SBA size determination with affiliates (P03 section 1.3)

obligation: Reportable Food Registry
trigger: Responsible party (the registrant of a food facility) determines a food is reportable
deadline: No later than 24 hours after the determination
notify: FDA
applies_at_this_tier: No - neither plant is an FDA-registered facility (21 CFR 1.226(g)); FSIS notice under 9 CFR 418.2 applies instead
owner: Vice President of Food Safety and Quality Assurance

obligation: Reporting of cyber incidents at MTSA facilities
trigger: Cyber incident at an MTSA-regulated facility
deadline: Immediately (6.16-1); without delay to the National Response Center for entities not reporting under 6.16-1
notify: FBI, CISA, and the Coast Guard Captain of the Port; or the National Response Center
applies_at_this_tier: No - neither plant is an MTSA-regulated facility

obligation: Covered telecommunications or Kaspersky article discovered
trigger: Contractor identifies covered equipment or a Kaspersky covered article
deadline: Within 1 business day for covered telecommunications (52.204-25(d)); within 3 business days for a Kaspersky covered article (52.204-23(c)); further report within 10 business days in both cases
notify: Contracting officer
applies_at_this_tier: No - the company holds no federal contracts or subcontracts

obligation: Cyber insurance claim notice
trigger: Suspected security incident
deadline: Through the carrier breach hotline before engaging incident response vendors
notify: Carrier breach hotline ($15 million limit, $500,000 retention)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual

obligation: Customer food safety and supply notices
trigger: Event that could affect product safety or committed volumes, including any recall
deadline: Within 24 hours (largest customers); per each agreement otherwise
notify: Customer quality contacts
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual
owner: Vice President of Sales and Customer Service with the VP FSQA

obligation: Customer portal and EDI security incident notice
citation: Largest customer supply agreement (2026), security schedule (contract)
trigger: Security incident affecting the customer traceability portal or EDI services
deadline: Within 72 hours of confirming the incident
notify: Customer security contact
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - contractual
owner: Security Manager with the General Counsel

obligation: Board and sponsor notice
trigger: Severity 1 incident
deadline: Within 24 hours
notify: Audit committee chair; sponsor operating partner
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - governance
